zh: 稿子快交了。
你只想把眼前这一段，改得更清楚。
en: The draft is almost due.
You just want this one paragraph to read a little better.
sentences.zh_say: 稿子快交了。你只想把眼前这一段，改得更清楚。
sentences.en_say: The draft is almost due. You just want this one paragraph to read a little better.

zh: 你打开 Agent。它很能干，
可你还得解释：哪一页，哪一段，哪里别动。
en: You open your agent. It can do the work.
But first: which page, which paragraph, and what should stay untouched?
sentences.zh_say: 你打开 Agent。它很能干，可你还得解释：哪一页，哪一段，哪里别动。
sentences.en_say: You open your agent. It can do the work. But first: which page, which paragraph, and what should stay untouched?

title.en: What if you could just point?

zh: 如果……直接指给它看呢？
en: What if… you could simply point to it?
sentences.zh_say: 如果……直接指给它看呢？
sentences.en_say: What if… you could simply point to it?

title.zh: 选中 → 审阅 → 确认

zh: 选中，说要求。修改先摆在你眼前。
你确认，它才写回。
en: Select it. Say what you want. See the changes first.
They go into your document when you say yes.
sentences.zh_say: 选中，说要求。修改先摆在你眼前。你确认，它才写回。
sentences.en_say: Select it. Say what you want. See the changes first. They go into your document when you say yes.

zh: 这就是 LLM in Work。
让本机的 Claude Code 或 Codex，来到你正在工作的地方。
en: Meet LLM in Work.
Your local Claude Code or Codex, right where you are already working.
sentences.zh_say: 这就是 LLM in Work。让本机的 Claude Code 或 Codex，来到你正在工作的地方。
sentences.en_say: Meet LLM in Work. Your local Claude Code or Codex, right where you are already working.

zh: 先从 Word 开始。
选中这一段，也可以再加一段。改哪里，由你来指。
en: Start in Word.
Select this passage, and add another if you need it. You choose exactly where the work happens.
sentences.zh_say: 先从 Word 开始。选中这一段，也可以再加一段。改哪里，由你来指。
sentences.en_say: Start in Word. Select this passage, and add another if you need it. You choose exactly where the work happens.

zh: 想更简洁？保留所有数字？
把要求说清，红色和绿色，就把变化交代明白了。
en: Make it shorter. Keep every number.
Say what matters, then read the changes in red and green.
sentences.zh_say: 想更简洁？保留所有数字？把要求说清，红色和绿色，就把变化交代明白了。
sentences.en_say: Make it shorter. Keep every number. Say what matters, then read the changes in red and green.

zh: 满意，再点应用。它会写成 Word 修订，
接受还是拒绝，依然由你决定。
en: Happy with it? Apply it as Word tracked changes.
Accept or reject them, on your terms.
sentences.zh_say: 满意，再点应用。它会写成 Word 修订，接受还是拒绝，依然由你决定。
sentences.en_say: Happy with it? Apply it as Word tracked changes. Accept or reject them, on your terms.

zh: 换到 Overleaf，还是这个习惯。
圈出几段 LaTeX，不必来回复制。
en: Move into Overleaf, and keep the same rhythm.
Select a few LaTeX passages, right in the editor.
sentences.zh_say: 换到 Overleaf，还是这个习惯。圈出几段 LaTeX，不必来回复制。
sentences.en_say: Move into Overleaf, and keep the same rhythm. Select a few LaTeX passages, right in the editor.

zh: 整篇源码提供上下文，
每个选段都有自己的差异。引用和公式，也留在原来的位置。
en: The full source gives context.
Each passage gets its own diff, with citations and math kept intact.
sentences.zh_say: 整篇源码提供上下文，每个选段都有自己的差异。引用和公式，也留在原来的位置。
sentences.en_say: The full source gives context. Each passage gets its own diff, with citations and math kept intact.

zh: 看过以后，一起应用。想退回？
一次撤销，就回到刚才。
en: Review them, then apply the group. Changed your mind?
One undo takes the whole group back.
sentences.zh_say: 看过以后，一起应用。想退回？一次撤销，就回到刚才。
sentences.en_say: Review them, then apply the group. Changed your mind? One undo takes the whole group back.

zh: 再打开 Chrome 里的 PDF。
读到不明白的一句？选中，就在文档旁边问。
en: Now open a PDF in Chrome.
A sentence leaves you wondering? Select it, and ask beside the document.
sentences.zh_say: 再打开 Chrome 里的 PDF。读到不明白的一句？选中，就在文档旁边问。
sentences.en_say: Now open a PDF in Chrome. A sentence leaves you wondering? Select it, and ask beside the document.

zh: 遇到图表，也一样。
框出想讨论的部分，把真实图像交给模型。
en: A figure works the same way.
Frame the part you want to discuss, and let the model see the actual image.
sentences.zh_say: 遇到图表，也一样。框出想讨论的部分，把真实图像交给模型。
sentences.en_say: A figure works the same way. Frame the part you want to discuss, and let the model see the actual image.

zh: 问题跟着文档，
对话可以接着聊。你越读越明白，PDF 原文始终不变。
en: The conversation stays with the document.
Keep asking, keep understanding. The original PDF stays unchanged.
sentences.zh_say: 问题跟着文档，对话可以接着聊。你越读越明白，PDF 原文始终不变。
sentences.en_say: The conversation stays with the document. Keep asking, keep understanding. The original PDF stays unchanged.

zh: 接着是 PowerPoint。
标题太长，要点太散？把要改的内容选出来。
en: Next, PowerPoint.
A title that rambles? Bullets that feel too long? Choose what needs attention.
sentences.zh_say: 接着是 PowerPoint。标题太长，要点太散？把要改的内容选出来。
sentences.en_say: Next, PowerPoint. A title that rambles? Bullets that feel too long? Choose what needs attention.

title.en: See it before you apply it.

zh: 先看每个文本框怎么改，再决定是否应用。
变化的字词写回，原有格式尽量保留。
en: Review each text box, then decide what to apply.
Only changed words are written back, preserving the existing formatting.
sentences.zh_say: 先看每个文本框怎么改，再决定是否应用。变化的字词写回，原有格式尽量保留。
sentences.en_say: Review each text box, then decide what to apply. Only changed words are written back, preserving the existing formatting.

zh: 最后是 Excel。圈出一块数据，就能清洗整理；
预览只列出需要改变的单元格。
en: Finally, Excel. Select a range to clean up.
The preview shows exactly which cells will change.
sentences.zh_say: 最后是 Excel。圈出一块数据，就能清洗整理；预览只列出需要改变的单元格。
sentences.en_say: Finally, Excel. Select a range to clean up. The preview shows exactly which cells will change.

zh: 也可以选中空白列，让模型按每行内容补齐。
确认以后再写入，格式和编号仍然保留。
en: Or select an empty column, and fill it from each row’s context.
Confirm before writing, with formats and identifiers preserved.
sentences.zh_say: 也可以选中空白列，让模型按每行内容补齐。确认以后再写入，格式和编号仍然保留。
sentences.en_say: Or select an empty column, and fill it from each row’s context. Confirm before writing, with formats and identifiers preserved.

zh: 背后，用的就是本机已登录的 Claude Code 或 Codex。
不需要再配一把 API Key。
en: Behind it all is the Claude Code or Codex already signed in on your computer.
No extra API key to set up.
sentences.zh_say: 背后，用的就是本机已登录的 Claude Code 或 Codex。不需要再配一把 API Key。
sentences.en_say: Behind it all is the Claude Code or Codex already signed in on your computer. No extra API key to set up.

zh: 请求会通过本机桥交给对应的模型服务。
你留在文档里，保持自己的工作节奏。
en: A local bridge sends your request to the chosen model provider.
You stay in your document, and keep your flow.
sentences.zh_say: 请求会通过本机桥交给对应的模型服务。你留在文档里，保持自己的工作节奏。
sentences.en_say: A local bridge sends your request to the chosen model provider. You stay in your document, and keep your flow.

zh: 再回到开头那一段。
这一次，不用解释“这里”在哪里。选中，它就明白了。
en: Back to that opening paragraph.
This time, there is no need to explain where “here” is. Select it. That is the starting point.
sentences.zh_say: 再回到开头那一段。这一次，不用解释“这里”在哪里。选中，它就明白了。
sentences.en_say: Back to that opening paragraph. This time, there is no need to explain where “here” is. Select it. That is the starting point.

title.zh:
让 AI 帮你改。
让决定留给你。
title.en:
AI helps with the changes.
You keep the decisions.

zh: 让 AI 帮你改，让决定留给你。
LLM in Work，从你正在用的软件开始。
en: Let AI help with the changes. Keep the decisions for yourself.
LLM in Work. Start where you already work.
sentences.zh_say: 让 AI 帮你改，让决定留给你。LLM in Work，从你正在用的软件开始。
sentences.en_say: Let AI help with the changes. Keep the decisions for yourself. LLM in Work. Start where you already work.
